# osapi skill

Show and install the agent skills that this binary has.
`osapi dsl command get --name skill` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | skill                                                  |
| Description | Show and install the agent skills that this binary has |

## [osapi skill list](../../usage/cli/skill/list.md)

|             |                                      |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Method      | list                                 |
| Description | List the skills that this binary has |

## [osapi skill get](../../usage/cli/skill/get.md)

|             |                                              |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | get                                          |
| Description | Print a skill, or one of its reference files |
| Refuses     | no name                                      |

### Flags (2)

| FLAG        | TYPE   | VALIDATE  | HELP                                                     |
| ----------- | ------ | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| --name      | string | required  | Name of the skill                                        |
| --reference | string | omitempty | A reference file of the skill, relative to its directory |

## [osapi skill install](../../usage/cli/skill/install.md)

|             |                                                     |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | install                                             |
| Description | Install the skills of this binary into a repository |
| Refuses     | an unknown tool                                     |

### Flags (2)

| FLAG   | TYPE      | VALIDATE                          | HELP                                                                     |
| ------ | --------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| --path | string    | omitempty                         | The repository to install into; the current directory without it         |
| --tool | \[]string | omitempty,dive,oneof=claude codex | Agent tool to install for: claude, codex (repeatable); claude without it |
